## Services
- Operations & QA: call, email and chat audits against a scorecard; SOPs; weekly reports; meeting minutes; CRM follow-up in Salesforce, GoHighLevel and Real Geeks.
- Social media management: content calendars, captions, scheduling and posting for ten Facebook and Instagram accounts from one GoKaizn planner.
- Video & animation: vertical reels, brand films, explainers and animated shorts, from script to finished MP4.
- Web & AI automation: landing pages, booking pages and web apps; AI concierges; Claude skills; Zapier and Google Apps Script automations.

## Experience
- Pvblicly (current): founder, remote operations support for US real estate teams and local businesses; manages 10 social media pages; builds client websites.
- 10FC (Jan 2025 – present): Quality Assurance Analyst for Nooro, Lunavia and SØREN. Audits sales, recovery and CX calls; rebuilt the knowledge base behind the AI call-auditing pipeline; the CX team held a 97% CSAT.
- Pvblicly: built an AI concierge in GoHighLevel and Google AI Studio that answers and qualifies Airbnb guests 24/7.
- Ibex Global (Dec 2022 – Aug 2024): Quality Assurance Supervisor on a US B2B campaign; led 23 QA analysts across Jamaica, Honduras and the Philippines.
- Ibex Global (Sept 2020 – Dec 2022): Senior Quality Analyst, Business Insights Analyst, QA Analyst and Customer Service for US payment and crypto-wallet support.
